091        public static class Category {
092                public String base;
093                public Set<String> tags = new HashSet<String>();
094                
095                public List<String> fallback = new ArrayList<String>();
096                
097                public Category(String base, Map<String, Category> categories) {
098                        this.base = base;
099                        
100                        categories.put(base, this);
101                        for (int i = 0; i < 100; i++) {
102                                String id = base + i;
103                                tags.add(id);
104                                categories.put(id, this);
105                        }
106                }
107                
108                public void addFallback(String ... categories) {
109                        for (String catId : categories) {
110                                fallback.add(catId);
111                        }
112                }
113        }

140        public boolean isChecked(String id) {
141                for (AutofitOption option : options) {
142                        if (option.id.equals(id)) return option.checked;
143                }
144                return false;
145        }
146        
147        public void setChecked(String id, boolean checked) {
148                for (AutofitOption option : options) {
149                        if (option.id.equals(id)) {
150                                option.checked = checked;
151                                return;
152                        }
153                }
154        }

156        public CoreAutofitPlugin(PersonAPI fleetCommander) {
157                this.fleetCommander = fleetCommander;
158                if (fleetCommander != null) stats = fleetCommander.getStats();
159                options.add(new AutofitOption(USE_FROM_CARGO, "Use ordnance from cargo", true, 
160                                "Use weapons and fighter LPCs from your fleet's cargo holds."));
161                options.add(new AutofitOption(USE_FROM_STORAGE, "Use ordnance from storage", true, 
162                                "Use weapons and fighter LPCs from your local storage facilities."));
163                options.add(new AutofitOption(BUY_FROM_MARKET, "Buy ordnance from market", true, 
164                                "Buy weapons and fighter LPCs from market, if docked at one.\n\n" +
165                                "Ordnance from your cargo will be preferred if that option is checked and if the alternatives are of equal quality."));
166                options.add(new AutofitOption(BUY_FROM_BLACK_MARKET, "Allow black market purchases", true, 
167                                "Buy weapons and fighter LPCs from the black market.\n\n" +
168                                "Non-black-market options will be preferred if the alternatives are of equal quality."));
169                options.add(new AutofitOption(UPGRADE, "Upgrade weapons using extra OP", false, 
170                                "Use weapons better than the ones specified in the goal variant, if there are ordnance points left to mount them.\n\n" +
171                                "Will add flux vents and capacitors up to the number specified in the goal variant first, " +

173                                "Leaving some unspent ordnance points in a goal variant can help take advantage of this option."));
174                options.add(new AutofitOption(STRIP, "Strip before autofitting", true, 
175                                "Remove everything possible prior to autofitting; generally results in a better fit.\n\n" +
176                                "However, refitting outside of port reduces a ship's combat readiness, and this option tends to lead to more changes and more readiness lost."));

184                                "\"Blast Doors\" may still be added if this option isn't checked, provided there are enough ordnance points."));

222        protected void stripWeapons(ShipVariantAPI current, AutofitPluginDelegate delegate) {
223                for (String id : current.getFittedWeaponSlots()) {
224                        WeaponSlotAPI slot = current.getSlot(id);
225                        if (slot.isDecorative() || slot.isBuiltIn() || slot.isHidden() ||
226                                        slot.isSystemSlot() || slot.isStationModule()) continue;
227                        clearWeaponSlot(slot, delegate, current);
228                }
229        }
230        
231        protected void stripFighters(ShipVariantAPI current, AutofitPluginDelegate delegate) {
232                int numBays = 20; // well above whatever it might actually be
233                for (int i = 0; i < numBays; i++) {
234                        if (current.getWingId(i) != null) {
235                                clearFighterSlot(i, delegate, current);
236                        }
237                }
238        }

243        protected Map<String, AvailableFighter> fittedFighters = new HashMap<String, AvailableFighter>();

245        
246        public int getCreditCost() {
247                int cost = 0;
248                for (AvailableWeapon w : fittedWeapons.values()) {
249                        cost += w.getPrice();
250                }
251                for (AvailableFighter w : fittedFighters.values()) {
252                        cost += w.getPrice();
253                }
254                return cost;
255        }

257        protected Set<String> availableMods;
258        protected Set<String> slotsToSkip = new HashSet<String>();
259        protected Set<Integer> baysToSkip = new HashSet<Integer>();
260        protected boolean fittingModule = false;
261        protected int missilesWithAmmoOnCurrent = 0;
262        public void doFit(ShipVariantAPI current, ShipVariantAPI target, int maxSMods, AutofitPluginDelegate delegate) {
263                
264                
265//              if (stats == null) {
266//                      stats = Global.getFactory().createPerson().getStats();
267//                      stats.getShipOrdnancePointBonus().modifyPercent("test", 10f);
268//                      stats.getMaxVentsBonus().modifyPercent("test", 20f);
269//                      stats.getMaxCapacitorsBonus().modifyPercent("test", 20f);
270//              }
271                boolean player = fleetCommander != null && fleetCommander.isPlayer();
272                
273                if (!fittingModule) {
274                        fittedWeapons.clear();
275                        fittedFighters.clear();
276                        
277                        randomize = isChecked(RANDOMIZE);
278                        
279                        availableMods = new LinkedHashSet<String>(delegate.getAvailableHullmods());
280                }
281                
282//              if (fittingModule && current.getHullSpec().getHullId().equals("module_hightech_hangar")) {
283//                      System.out.println("wfweffewfew");
284//              }
285                
286                current.setMayAutoAssignWeapons(false);
287                current.getStationModules().putAll(target.getStationModules());
288
289                int index = 0;
290                for (String slotId : current.getStationModules().keySet()) {
291                        ShipVariantAPI moduleCurrent = current.getModuleVariant(slotId);
292                        boolean forceClone = false;
293                        if (moduleCurrent == null) {
294                                // when the target variant is not stock and has custom variants for the modules, grab them
295                                forceClone = true;
296                                moduleCurrent = target.getModuleVariant(slotId);
297                                //continue;
298                        }
299                        if (moduleCurrent == null) {
300                                String variantId = current.getHullVariantId();
301                                throw new RuntimeException("Module variant for slotId [" + slotId + "] not found for " +
302                                                                                  "variantId [" + variantId + "] of hull [" + current.getHullSpec().getHullId() + "]");
303                                //continue;
304                        }
305                        if (moduleCurrent.isStockVariant() || forceClone) {
306                                moduleCurrent = moduleCurrent.clone();
307                                moduleCurrent.setSource(VariantSource.REFIT);
308                                if (!forceClone) {
309                                        moduleCurrent.setHullVariantId(moduleCurrent.getHullVariantId() + "_" + index);
310                                }
311                        }
312                        index++;
313                        
314//                              String variantId = current.getStationModules().get(slotId);
315//                              ShipVariantAPI moduleTarget = Global.getSettings().getVariant(variantId);
316                        ShipVariantAPI moduleTarget = target.getModuleVariant(slotId);
317                        if (moduleTarget == null) continue;
318                        
319                        fittingModule = true;
320                        doFit(moduleCurrent, moduleTarget, 0, delegate);
321                        fittingModule = false;
322                        
323                        current.setModuleVariant(slotId, moduleCurrent);
324                }
325                current.setSource(VariantSource.REFIT);
326                
327                weaponFilterSeed = random.nextLong();
328                
329                emptyWingTarget = null;
330                if (delegate.getAvailableFighters().size() > 0) {
331                        emptyWingTarget = delegate.getAvailableFighters().get(random.nextInt(delegate.getAvailableFighters().size())).getId();
332                }
333                
334                altWeaponCats.clear();
335                altFighterCats.clear();
336                
337                slotsToSkip.clear();
338                baysToSkip.clear();
339                
340                missilesWithAmmoOnCurrent = 0;
341                
342                boolean strip = isChecked(STRIP);
343                if (strip) {
344                        stripWeapons(current, delegate);
345                        stripFighters(current, delegate);
346                        
347                        current.setNumFluxCapacitors(0);
348                        current.setNumFluxVents(0);
349                        if (delegate.isPlayerCampaignRefit()) {
350                                for (String modId : current.getNonBuiltInHullmods()) {
351                                        boolean canRemove = delegate.canAddRemoveHullmodInPlayerCampaignRefit(modId);
352                                        if (canRemove) {
353                                                current.removeMod(modId);
354                                        }
355                                }       
356                        } else {
357                                current.clearHullMods();
358                        }
359                        if (!fittingModule) {
360                                delegate.syncUIWithVariant(current);
361                        }
362                } else {
363                        slotsToSkip.addAll(current.getFittedWeaponSlots()); 
364                        for (int i = 0; i < 20; i++) {
365                                String wingId = current.getWingId(i);
366                                if (wingId != null && !wingId.isEmpty()) {
367                                        baysToSkip.add(i);
368                                }
369                        }
370                }
371                
372                //boolean randomize = isChecked(RANDOMIZE);
373                
374                
375                boolean reinforcedHull = isChecked(ALWAYS_REINFORCED_HULL);
376                boolean blastDoors = isChecked(ALWAYS_BLAST_DOORS);
377                
378                if (reinforcedHull) {
379                        addHullmods(current, delegate, HullMods.REINFORCEDHULL);
380                }
381                if (blastDoors) {
382                        addHullmods(current, delegate, HullMods.BLAST_DOORS);
383                }
384
385                List<String> targetMods = new ArrayList<String>();
386                for (String id : target.getSMods()) {
387                        if (target.getSModdedBuiltIns().contains(id)) continue;
388                        targetMods.add(id);
389                }
390                for (String id : target.getNonBuiltInHullmods()) {
391                        //if (HullMods.FLUX_DISTRIBUTOR.equals(id) || HullMods.FLUX_COIL.equals(id)) continue;
392                        targetMods.add(id);
393                }
394                if (!targetMods.isEmpty()) {
395                        addHullmods(current, delegate, targetMods.toArray(new String[0]));
396                }
397                
398                int addedRandomHullmodPts = 0;
399                if (randomize) {
400                        addedRandomHullmodPts = addRandomizedHullmodsPre(current, delegate);
401                }
402                
403                
404                fitFighters(current, target, false, delegate);
405                fitWeapons(current, target, false, delegate);
406
407                if (current.hasHullMod(HullMods.FRAGILE_SUBSYSTEMS) && 
408                                (current.getHullSize() == HullSize.FRIGATE || current.getHullSize() == HullSize.DESTROYER)) {
409                        addHullmods(current, delegate, HullMods.HARDENED_SUBSYSTEMS);
410                }
411                
412                
413                float addedMax = current.getHullSpec().getOrdnancePoints(stats) * 0.1f;
414                if (randomize && addedRandomHullmodPts <= addedMax) {
415                        addRandomizedHullmodsPost(current, delegate);
416                }
417                
418                float ventsCapsFraction = 1f;
419                boolean upgrade = isChecked(UPGRADE);
420                if (upgrade) {
421                        ventsCapsFraction = 0.5f;
422                        //ventsCapsFraction = 0f;
423                }
424                
425                addVentsAndCaps(current, target, ventsCapsFraction);
426
427                
428                // now that we're at the target level of vents and caps
429                // see if we can upgrade some weapons
430                if (upgrade) {
431                        fitFighters(current, target, true, delegate);
432                        fitWeapons(current, target, true, delegate);
433                        addVentsAndCaps(current, target, 1f - ventsCapsFraction);
434                }
435                
436//              float dissipation = current.getHullSpec().getFluxDissipation() + current.getNumFluxVents() * 10f;
437//              float generation = 0f;
438//              for (String slotId : current.getFittedWeaponSlots()) {
439//                      WeaponSpecAPI spec = current.getWeaponSpec(slotId);
440//                      generation += spec.getDerivedStats().getSustainedFluxPerSecond();
441//              }
442                
443                addExtraVentsAndCaps(current, target);
444                addHullmods(current, delegate, HullMods.REINFORCEDHULL, HullMods.BLAST_DOORS, HullMods.HARDENED_SUBSYSTEMS);
445                addModsWithSpareOPIfAny(current, target, false, delegate);
446                
447                //maxSMods = 2;
448                if (maxSMods > 0) {
449                        int added = convertToSMods(current, maxSMods);
450                        addExtraVents(current);
451                        addExtraCaps(current);
452                        //addHullmods(current, delegate, HullMods.FLUX_DISTRIBUTOR, HullMods.FLUX_COIL);
453                        if (!current.hasHullMod(HullMods.FLUX_DISTRIBUTOR)) {
454                                addDistributor(current, delegate);
455                        }
456                        if (!current.hasHullMod(HullMods.FLUX_COIL)) {
457                                addCoil(current, delegate);
458                        }
459                        //addModsWithSpareOPIfAny(current, target, true, delegate);
460                        //addHullmods(current, delegate, HullMods.FLUX_DISTRIBUTOR, HullMods.FLUX_COIL);
461                        if (current.getHullSize() == HullSize.FRIGATE || current.hasHullMod(HullMods.SAFETYOVERRIDES)) {
462                                addHullmods(current, delegate, HullMods.HARDENED_SUBSYSTEMS, HullMods.REINFORCEDHULL, HullMods.BLAST_DOORS);
463                        } else {
464                                addHullmods(current, delegate, HullMods.REINFORCEDHULL, HullMods.BLAST_DOORS, HullMods.HARDENED_SUBSYSTEMS);
465                        }
466                        int remaining = maxSMods - added;
467                        if (remaining > 0) {
468                                List<String> mods = new ArrayList<String>();
469                                mods.add(HullMods.FLUX_DISTRIBUTOR);
470                                mods.add(HullMods.FLUX_COIL);
471                                if (current.getHullSize() == HullSize.FRIGATE || current.hasHullMod(HullMods.SAFETYOVERRIDES)) {
472                                        mods.add(HullMods.HARDENED_SUBSYSTEMS);
473                                        mods.add(HullMods.REINFORCEDHULL);
474                                } else {
475                                        mods.add(HullMods.REINFORCEDHULL);
476                                        mods.add(HullMods.HARDENED_SUBSYSTEMS);
477                                }
478                                mods.add(HullMods.BLAST_DOORS);
479                                Iterator<String> iter = mods.iterator();
480                                while (iter.hasNext()) {
481                                        String modId = iter.next();
482                                        if (current.getPermaMods().contains(modId)) {
483                                                iter.remove();
484                                        }
485                                }
486//                              while (!mods.isEmpty() && current.hasHullMod(mods.get(0))) {
487//                                      mods.remove(0);
488//                              }
489                                for (int i = 0; i < remaining && !mods.isEmpty(); i++) {
490                                        current.setNumFluxCapacitors(0);
491                                        current.setNumFluxVents(0);
492                                        String modId = mods.get(Math.min(i, mods.size() - 1));
493                                        addHullmods(current, delegate, modId);
494                                        convertToSMods(current, 1);
495//                                      addExtraVents(current);
496//                                      addExtraCaps(current);
497                                }
498                        }
499                }
500                
501                
502                if (current.getHullSpec().isPhase()) {
503                        addExtraCaps(current);
504                } else {
505                        addExtraVents(current);
506                }
507                
508                addHullmods(current, delegate, HullMods.ARMOREDWEAPONS);
509                int opCost = current.computeOPCost(stats);
510                int opMax = current.getHullSpec().getOrdnancePoints(stats);
511                int opLeft = opMax - opCost;
512                if (opLeft > 0) {
513                        addRandomizedHullmodsPost(current, delegate);
514                }
515                
516                if (current.getHullSpec().isPhase()) {
517                        addExtraVents(current);
518                } else {
519                        addExtraCaps(current);
520                }
521                
522                
523                current.setVariantDisplayName(target.getDisplayName());
524                
525                current.getWeaponGroups().clear();
526                for (WeaponGroupSpec group : target.getWeaponGroups()) {
527                        WeaponGroupSpec copy = new WeaponGroupSpec(group.getType());
528                        copy.setAutofireOnByDefault(group.isAutofireOnByDefault());
529                        for (String slotId : group.getSlots()) {
530                                if (current.getWeaponId(slotId) != null) {
531                                        copy.addSlot(slotId);
532                                }
533                        }
534                        if (!copy.getSlots().isEmpty()) {
535                                current.addWeaponGroup(copy);
536                        }
537                }
538                
539                if (player) {
540                        if (current.getWeaponGroups().isEmpty() || randomize || current.hasUnassignedWeapons()) {
541                                current.setMayAutoAssignWeapons(true);
542                                current.autoGenerateWeaponGroups();
543                        }
544                        //current.assignUnassignedWeapons();                    
545                } else {
546                        current.getWeaponGroups().clear(); // will get auto-assigned when deployed in combat; until then don't care
547                }
548                
549                if (!fittingModule) {
550                        delegate.syncUIWithVariant(current);
551                }
552        }

554        protected int convertToSMods(ShipVariantAPI current, int num) {
555                if (num <= 0) return 0;
556                
557                List<HullModSpecAPI> mods = new ArrayList<HullModSpecAPI>(); 
558                for (String id : current.getHullMods()) {
559                        if (current.getPermaMods().contains(id)) continue;
560                        if (current.getHullSpec().getBuiltInMods().contains(id)) continue;
561                        HullModSpecAPI mod = DModManager.getMod(id);
562                        if (mod.hasTag(Tags.HULLMOD_NO_BUILD_IN)) continue;
563                        mods.add(mod);
564                }
565                
566                final HullSize size = current.getHullSize();
567                Collections.sort(mods, new Comparator<HullModSpecAPI>() {
568                        public int compare(HullModSpecAPI o1, HullModSpecAPI o2) {
569                                return Misc.getOPCost(o2, size) - Misc.getOPCost(o1, size);
570                        }
571                });
572                
573                int count = 0;
574                for (int i = 0; i < num && i < mods.size(); i++) {
575                        String id = mods.get(i).getId();
576                        current.addPermaMod(id, true);
577                        count++;
578                }
579                return count;
580        }

582        protected void addModsWithSpareOPIfAny(ShipVariantAPI current, ShipVariantAPI target, boolean sModMode, AutofitPluginDelegate delegate) {
583                int opCost = current.computeOPCost(stats);
584                int opMax = current.getHullSpec().getOrdnancePoints(stats);
585                int opLeft = opMax - opCost;
586        
587                if (opLeft <= 0) return;
588                
589                float total = target.getNumFluxVents() + target.getNumFluxCapacitors();
590                float ventsFraction = 1f;
591                if (total > 0) {
592                        ventsFraction = target.getNumFluxVents() / total;
593                }
594                
595                if (sModMode) {
596                        if (ventsFraction >= 0.5f) {
597                                addDistributorRemoveVentsIfNeeded(current, delegate);
598                                addCoilRemoveCapsIfNeeded(current, delegate);
599                        } else {
600                                addCoil(current, delegate);
601                                addCoilRemoveCapsIfNeeded(current, delegate);
602                        }
603                } else {
604                        if (ventsFraction >= 0.5f) {
605                                addDistributor(current, delegate);
606                                addCoil(current, delegate);
607                        } else {
608                                addCoil(current, delegate);
609                                addDistributor(current, delegate);
610                        }
611                }
612        }

614        protected void addCoil(ShipVariantAPI current, AutofitPluginDelegate delegate) {
615                int opCost = current.computeOPCost(stats);
616                int opMax = current.getHullSpec().getOrdnancePoints(stats);
617                int opLeft = opMax - opCost;
618        
619                if (opLeft <= 0) return;
620                
621                int vents = current.getNumFluxVents();
622                
623                HullModSpecAPI coil = Misc.getMod(HullMods.FLUX_COIL);
624                int cost = coil.getCostFor(current.getHullSize());
625                
626                if (cost < opLeft + vents * 0.3f) {
627                        int remove = cost - opLeft;
628                        if (remove > 0) {
629                                opLeft -= addVents(-remove, current, 1000);
630                        }
631                        opLeft -= addModIfPossible(HullMods.FLUX_COIL, delegate, current, opLeft);
632                }
633        }

700        protected List<AvailableWeapon> getWeapons(AutofitPluginDelegate delegate) {
701                boolean buy = isChecked(BUY_FROM_MARKET);
702                boolean storage = isChecked(USE_FROM_STORAGE);
703                boolean useCargo = isChecked(USE_FROM_CARGO);
704                boolean useBlack = isChecked(BUY_FROM_BLACK_MARKET);
705                
706                List<AvailableWeapon> weapons = new ArrayList<AvailableWeapon>(delegate.getAvailableWeapons());
707                
708                Iterator<AvailableWeapon> iter = weapons.iterator();
709                while (iter.hasNext()) {
710                        AvailableWeapon w = iter.next();
711                        if ((!buy && w.getPrice() > 0) ||
712                                (!storage && w.getPrice() <= 0 && w.getSubmarket() != null) ||
713                                (!useCargo && w.getSubmarket() == null) ||
714                                (!useBlack && w.getSubmarket() != null && w.getSubmarket().getPlugin().isBlackMarket())) {
715                                iter.remove();
716                        }
717                }
718                return weapons;
719        }

721        protected List<AvailableFighter> getFighters(AutofitPluginDelegate delegate) {
722                boolean buy = isChecked(BUY_FROM_MARKET);
723                boolean storage = isChecked(USE_FROM_STORAGE);
724                boolean useCargo = isChecked(USE_FROM_CARGO);
725                boolean useBlack = isChecked(BUY_FROM_BLACK_MARKET);

727                boolean automated = Misc.isAutomated(delegate.getShip());
728                List<AvailableFighter> fighters = new ArrayList<AvailableFighter>(delegate.getAvailableFighters());
729                Iterator<AvailableFighter> iter = fighters.iterator();

733                                (automated && !f.getWingSpec().hasTag(Tags.AUTOMATED_FIGHTER)) ||
734                                (!storage && f.getPrice() <= 0 && f.getSubmarket() != null) ||
735                                (!useCargo && f.getSubmarket() == null) ||
736                                (!useBlack && f.getSubmarket() != null && f.getSubmarket().getPlugin().isBlackMarket())) {
737                                iter.remove();
738                        }
739                }
740                return fighters;
741        }

743        public int addHullmods(ShipVariantAPI current, AutofitPluginDelegate delegate, String ... mods) {
744                if (fittingModule) return 0;
745                
746                int opCost = current.computeOPCost(stats);
747                int opMax = current.getHullSpec().getOrdnancePoints(stats);
748                int opLeft = opMax - opCost;
749                
750                int addedTotal = 0;
751                for (String mod : mods) {
752                        if (current.hasHullMod(mod)) continue;
753//                      if (mod.equals(HullMods.INTEGRATED_TARGETING_UNIT)) {
754//                              System.out.println("wefwefwefe");
755//                      }
756                        if (!availableMods.contains(mod)) {
757                                if (mod.equals(HullMods.INTEGRATED_TARGETING_UNIT) && 
758                                                current.getHullSize().ordinal() >= HullSize.CRUISER.ordinal()) {
759                                        mod = HullMods.DEDICATED_TARGETING_CORE;
760                                } else {
761                                        continue;
762                                }
763                        }
764                        
765                        if (mod.equals(HullMods.DEDICATED_TARGETING_CORE) && 
766                                        availableMods.contains(HullMods.INTEGRATED_TARGETING_UNIT)) {
767                                mod = HullMods.INTEGRATED_TARGETING_UNIT;
768                        }
769                        
770                        HullModSpecAPI modSpec = Misc.getMod(mod);
771                        
772                        if (mod.equals(HullMods.INTEGRATED_TARGETING_UNIT) && 
773                                        current.hasHullMod(HullMods.DEDICATED_TARGETING_CORE)) {
774                                current.removeMod(HullMods.DEDICATED_TARGETING_CORE);
775                                HullModSpecAPI dtc = Misc.getMod(HullMods.DEDICATED_TARGETING_CORE);
776                                int cost = dtc.getCostFor(current.getHullSize());;
777                                addedTotal -= cost;
778                                opLeft += cost;
779                        }
780                        
781                        
782                        if (current.hasHullMod(HullMods.ADVANCED_TARGETING_CORE) || current.hasHullMod(HullMods.DISTRIBUTED_FIRE_CONTROL)) {
783                                if (mod.equals(HullMods.INTEGRATED_TARGETING_UNIT)) {
784                                        continue;
785                                }
786                                if (mod.equals(HullMods.DEDICATED_TARGETING_CORE)) {
787                                        continue;
788                                }
789                        }
790                        
791                        if (current.getHullSpec().isPhase()) {
792                                if (modSpec.hasTag(HullMods.TAG_NON_PHASE)) {
793                                        continue;
794                                }
795                        }
796                        if (!current.getHullSpec().isPhase()) {
797                                if (modSpec.hasTag(HullMods.TAG_PHASE)) {
798                                        continue;
799                                }
800                        }
801                        
802                        int cost = addModIfPossible(modSpec, delegate, current, opLeft);;
803                        //int cost = addModIfPossible(mod, delegate, current, opLeft);
804                        
805                        opLeft -= cost;
806                        addedTotal += cost;
807                }
808                return addedTotal;
809        }

811        public int addModIfPossible(String id, AutofitPluginDelegate delegate, ShipVariantAPI current, int opLeft) {
812                if (current.hasHullMod(id)) return 0;
813                if (delegate.isPlayerCampaignRefit() && !delegate.canAddRemoveHullmodInPlayerCampaignRefit(id)) return 0;
814                
815                HullModSpecAPI mod = Misc.getMod(id);
816                return addModIfPossible(mod, delegate, current, opLeft);

818        
819        public int addModIfPossible(HullModSpecAPI mod, AutofitPluginDelegate delegate, ShipVariantAPI current, int opLeft) {
820                if (mod == null) return 0;
821                
822                if (current.hasHullMod(mod.getId())) return 0;
823                if (delegate.isPlayerCampaignRefit() && !delegate.canAddRemoveHullmodInPlayerCampaignRefit(mod.getId())) return 0;
824                
825                
826                int cost = mod.getCostFor(current.getHullSize());
827                if (cost > opLeft) return 0;
828
829                ShipAPI ship = delegate.getShip();
830                ShipVariantAPI orig = null;
831                // why is this commented out? It fixes an issue with logistics hullmods not being properly applied
832                // if the current variant already has some
833                // but probably? causes some other issues
834                // possibly: it was not setting the orig variant back when returning 0; this is now fixed
835                if (ship != null) {
836                        orig = ship.getVariant();
837                        ship.setVariantForHullmodCheckOnly(current);
838                }
839                if (ship != null && mod.getEffect() != null && ship.getVariant() != null && !mod.getEffect().isApplicableToShip(ship)
840                                && !ship.getVariant().hasHullMod(mod.getId())) {
841                        if (orig != null) {
842                                ship.setVariantForHullmodCheckOnly(orig);
843                        }
844                        return 0;
845                }
846                
847                boolean hasItemIfAny = HullModItemManager.getInstance().isRequiredItemAvailable(mod.getId(), 
848                                                                delegate.getFleetMember(), current, delegate.getMarket());
849                if (!hasItemIfAny) {
850                        if (orig != null) {
851                                ship.setVariantForHullmodCheckOnly(orig);
852                        }
853                        return 0;
854                }
855                
856                
857                if (orig != null && ship != null) {
858                        ship.setVariantForHullmodCheckOnly(orig);
859                }
860                
861                current.addMod(mod.getId());
862                
863                if (ship != null && mod.getId() != null && mod.getEffect() != null) {
864                        if (!mod.hasTag(Tags.DO_NOT_APPLY_HULLMOD_DURING_AUTOFIT)) {
865                                mod.getEffect().applyEffectsBeforeShipCreation(ship.getHullSize(), ship.getMutableStats(), mod.getId());
866                                mod.getEffect().applyEffectsAfterShipCreation(ship, mod.getId());
867                                mod.getEffect().applyEffectsAfterShipCreation2ndPass(ship, mod.getId());
868                        }
869                }
870                return cost;
871        }

875        public void addVentsAndCaps(ShipVariantAPI current, ShipVariantAPI target, float fraction) {
876                if (fraction < 0) return;
877                
878                int opCost = current.computeOPCost(stats);
879                int opMax = current.getHullSpec().getOrdnancePoints(stats);
880                int opLeft = opMax - opCost;
881                
882                int maxVents = getMaxVents(current.getHullSize());
883                int maxCapacitors = getMaxCaps(current.getHullSize());
884                
885                int add = Math.max((int)Math.ceil(target.getNumFluxVents() * fraction) - current.getNumFluxVents(), 0);
886                if (add > opLeft) add = opLeft;
887                opLeft -= addVents(add, current, maxVents);
888                
889                add = Math.max((int)Math.ceil(target.getNumFluxCapacitors() * fraction) - current.getNumFluxCapacitors(), 0);
890                if (add > opLeft) add = opLeft;
891                opLeft -= addCapacitors(add, current, maxCapacitors);
892        }

918                int opMax = current.getHullSpec().getOrdnancePoints(stats);
919                int opLeft = opMax - opCost;
920                
921                int maxVents = getMaxVents(current.getHullSize());
922                int maxCapacitors = getMaxCaps(current.getHullSize());
923                if (opLeft > 0) {
924                        
925                        float total = current.getNumFluxVents() + current.getNumFluxCapacitors();
926                        float ventsFraction = 1f;
927                        if (total > 0) {
928                                ventsFraction = current.getNumFluxVents() / total;
929                        }
930                        
931                        int add = (int) (opLeft * ventsFraction);
932                        opLeft -= addVents(add, current, maxVents);
933                        add = opLeft;
934                        opLeft -= addCapacitors(add, current, maxCapacitors);
935                        
936                        add = opLeft;
937                        opLeft -= addVents(add, current, maxVents);
938                
939                        // if we ended up with more capacitors than desired, move some of them to vents
940                        if (target != null) {
941                                float targetVents = target.getNumFluxVents();
942                                float targetCaps = target.getNumFluxCapacitors();
943                                
944                                if (targetVents > targetCaps || targetVents >= maxVents) {
945                                        float currVents = current.getNumFluxVents();
946                                        float currCaps = current.getNumFluxCapacitors();
947                                        float currTotal = currVents + currCaps;
948                                        
949                                        int currVentsDesired = (int) (currVents + currCaps * 0.5f);
950                                        if (currVentsDesired > maxVents) currVentsDesired = maxVents;
951                                        int currCapsDesired = (int) (currTotal - currVentsDesired);
952                                        if (currCapsDesired > maxCapacitors) currCapsDesired = maxCapacitors;
953                                        current.setNumFluxVents(currVentsDesired);
954                                        current.setNumFluxCapacitors(currCapsDesired);
955                                }
956                                
957        //                      if (targetVents > 0 && currVents + currCaps > 0) {
958        //                              float ratioTarget = targetVents / (targetVents + targetCaps);
959        //                              float ratioCurr = currVents / (currVents + currCaps);
960        //                              if (ratioTarget > ratioCurr) {
961        //                                      float currTotal = currVents + currCaps;
962        //                                      int currVentsDesired = (int) (ratioTarget * currTotal);
963        //                                      if (currVentsDesired > maxVents) currVentsDesired = maxVents;
964        //                                      int currCapsDesired = (int) (currTotal - currVents);
965        //                                      if (currCapsDesired > maxCapacitors) currCapsDesired = maxCapacitors;

992                int max = 100;

1003        public int addVents(int add, ShipVariantAPI current, int max) {
1004                int target = current.getNumFluxVents() + add;
1005                if (target > max) target = max;
1006                if (target < 0) target = 0;
1007                int actual = target - current.getNumFluxVents();
1008                current.setNumFluxVents(target);
1009                return actual;
1010        }

1015                if (target < 0) target = 0;
1016                int actual = target - current.getNumFluxCapacitors();
1017                current.setNumFluxCapacitors(target);
1018                return actual;
1019        }

1031        public void fitWeapons(ShipVariantAPI current, ShipVariantAPI target, boolean upgradeMode, AutofitPluginDelegate delegate) {
1032                
1033                //upgradeMode = false;
1034                //boolean upgradeWhenNothingMatchingInPrimary = isChecked(UPGRADE);
1035                
1036                //boolean randomize = isChecked(RANDOMIZE);
1037                
1038                Set<String> alreadyUsed = new HashSet<String>();
1039                for (WeaponSlotAPI slot : getWeaponSlotsInPriorityOrder(current, target, upgradeMode)) {
1040                        if (slotsToSkip.contains(slot.getId())) continue;
1041                        
1042//                      if (slot.getId().equals("WS 004")) {
1043//                              System.out.println("wefwefwef");
1044//                      }
1045                        
1046                        float opCost = current.computeOPCost(stats);
1047                        float opMax = current.getHullSpec().getOrdnancePoints(stats);
1048                        float opLeft = opMax - opCost;
1049                        
1050                        float levelToBeat = -1;
1051                        if (upgradeMode) {
1052                                WeaponSpecAPI curr = current.getWeaponSpec(slot.getId());
1053                                if (curr != null) {
1054                                        float cost = curr.getOrdnancePointCost(stats, current.getStatsForOpCosts());
1055                                        opLeft += cost;
1056                                        
1057                                        for (String tag : curr.getTags()) {
1058                                                levelToBeat = Math.max(levelToBeat, getLevel(tag));
1059                                        }
1060                                        if (delegate.isPriority(curr)) {
1061                                                levelToBeat += PRIORITY;
1062                                        }
1063                                }
1064                        }
1065                        
1066                        WeaponSpecAPI desired = target.getWeaponSpec(slot.getId());
1067                        // shouldn't happen since it should be filtered out by getWeaponSlotsInPriorityOrder()
1068                        if (desired == null) continue;
1069                        
1070                        List<AvailableWeapon> weapons = getWeapons(delegate);
1071                        List<AvailableWeapon> possible = getPossibleWeapons(slot, desired, current, opLeft, weapons);
1072                        if (possible.isEmpty()) continue;
1073                        
1074//                      for (AvailableWeapon w : possible) {
1075//                              if (w.getSpec().getWeaponId().equals("harpoonpod")) {
1076//                                      System.out.println("wefwef");
1077//                              }
1078//                      }
1079                        
1080                        
1081                        List<String> categories = desired.getAutofitCategoriesInPriorityOrder(); 
1082                        List<String> alternate = altWeaponCats.get(desired);
1083                        RANDOMIZE_CHANCE = 1f;
1084                        if (false && randomize && (alternate != null || random.nextFloat() < RANDOMIZE_CHANCE)) {
1085                                if (alternate == null) {
1086                                        alternate = new ArrayList<String>();
1087                                        for (String cat : categories) {
1088                                                Category category = this.categories.get(cat);
1089                                                if (category == null) {
1090                                                        //System.out.println("ewfwefew");
1091                                                        continue;
1092                                                }
1093                                                if (!category.fallback.isEmpty()) {
1094                                                        int index = random.nextInt(category.fallback.size()/2) + 1;
1095                                                        //int index = random.nextInt(category.fallback.size());
1096                                                        if (index != 0) {
1097                                                                alternate.add(category.fallback.get(index));
1098                                                        }
1099                                                }
1100                                        }
1101                                        altWeaponCats.put(desired, alternate);
1102                                }
1103                                if (!alternate.isEmpty()) {
1104                                        categories = alternate;
1105                                }

1304        public AvailableWeapon getBestMatch(WeaponSpecAPI desired, boolean useBetter,
1305                                                                                String catId, Set<String> alreadyUsed, List<AvailableWeapon> possible,
1306                                                                                WeaponSlotAPI slot,
1307                                                                                AutofitPluginDelegate delegate) {
1308                //AvailableWeapon best = null;
1309                float bestScore = -1f;
1310                boolean bestIsPriority = false;
1311                int bestSize = -1;
1312                
1313                Category cat = categories.get(catId);
1314                if (cat == null) return null;
1315                
1316                String desiredTag = getCategoryTag(cat, desired.getTags());
1317                float desiredLevel = getLevel(desiredTag);
1318                
1319                if (desiredTag == null) {
1320                        // fallback to categories that aren't in the tags of the desired weapon
1321//                      for (String tag : desired.getTags()) {
1322//                              desiredLevel = Math.max(desiredLevel, getLevel(tag));
1323//                      }
1324                        desiredLevel = 10000f;
1325                }
1326                
1327                boolean longRange = desired.hasTag(LR);
1328                boolean shortRange = desired.hasTag(SR);
1329                boolean midRange = !longRange && !shortRange;
1330                boolean desiredPD = desired.getAIHints().contains(AIHints.PD);
1331                
1332                WeightedRandomPicker<AvailableWeapon> best = new WeightedRandomPicker<AvailableWeapon>(random);
1333                
1334                
1335//              boolean randomize = isChecked(RANDOMIZE);
1336//              if (randomize) {
1337//                      shortRange = true;
1338//                      longRange = false;
1339//                      midRange = !longRange && !shortRange;
1340//                      desiredPD = true;
1341//              }
1342                
1343                int iter = 0;
1344                for (AvailableWeapon w : possible) {
1345                        iter++;
1346                        WeaponSpecAPI spec = w.getSpec();
1347                        String catTag = getCategoryTag(cat, spec.getTags());
1348                        if (catTag == null) continue; // not in this category
1349                        
1350//                      if (desired.getWeaponId().equals("autopulse") && spec.getWeaponId().contains("phase")) {
1351//                              System.out.println("wefwefwe");
1352//                      }
1353                        
1354                        boolean currLongRange = spec.hasTag(LR);
1355                        boolean currShortRange = spec.hasTag(SR);
1356                        boolean currMidRange = !currLongRange && !currShortRange;
1357                        
1358                        // don't fit short-range weapons instead of long-range ones unless it's PD 
1359                        if (!desiredPD && currShortRange && (midRange || longRange)) continue;
1360                        //if (currMidRange && longRange) continue;
1361                        
1362                        boolean isPrimaryCategory = cat.base.equals(spec.getAutofitCategory());
1363                        boolean currIsPriority = isPrimaryCategory && delegate.isPriority(spec);
1364                        int currSize = spec.getSize().ordinal();
1365                        boolean betterDueToPriority = currSize >= bestSize && currIsPriority && !bestIsPriority;
1366                        boolean worseDueToPriority = currSize <= bestSize && !currIsPriority && bestIsPriority;
1367                        
1368                        if (worseDueToPriority) continue;
1369                        
1370                        float level = getLevel(catTag);
1371                        //if (randomize) level += random.nextInt(20);
1372                        if (!randomize && !useBetter && !betterDueToPriority && level > desiredLevel) continue;
1373                        int rMag = 0;
1374                        if (randomize && desired.getSize() == spec.getSize()) {
1375                                rMag = 20;
1376                        } else if (desired.getSize() == spec.getSize()) {
1377                                //if (delegate.getFaction() != null && delegate.getFaction().getDoctrine().getAutofitRandomizeProbability() > 0) {
1378                                if (delegate.isAllowSlightRandomization()) {
1379                                        rMag = 4;
1380                                }
1381                        }
1382                        if (rMag > 0) {
1383                                boolean symmetric = random.nextFloat() < 0.75f;
1384                                if (slot != null && symmetric) {
1385                                        long seed = (Math.abs((int)(slot.getLocation().x/2f)) * 723489413945245311L) ^ 1181783497276652981L;
1386                                        Random r = new Random((seed + weaponFilterSeed) * iter);
1387                                        level += r.nextInt(rMag);
1388                                } else {
1389                                        level += random.nextInt(rMag);
1390                                }
1391                        }
1392                        
1393                        
1394                        float score = level;
1395//                      if (delegate.isPriority(spec)) {
1396//                              score += PRIORITY;
1397//                      }
1398                        if ((score > bestScore || betterDueToPriority)) {
1399                                //best = w;
1400                                best.clear();
1401                                best.add(w);
1402                                bestScore = score;
1403                                bestSize = currSize;
1404                                bestIsPriority = currIsPriority;
1405                        } else if (score == bestScore) {
1406                                best.add(w);
1407                        }
1408                }
1409//              if (desired.getWeaponId().equals("autopulse")) {
1410//                      System.out.println("wefwefwe");
1411//              }
1412                
1413                
1414                // if the best-match tier includes the weapon specified in the target variant, use that
1415                // prefer one we already have to buying
1416                List<AvailableWeapon> allMatches = new ArrayList<AvailableWeapon>();
1417                List<AvailableWeapon> freeMatches = new ArrayList<AvailableWeapon>();
1418                for (AvailableWeapon w : best.getItems()) {
1419                        if (desired.getWeaponId().equals(w.getId())) {
1420                                allMatches.add(w);
1421                                if (w.getPrice() <= 0) {
1422                                        freeMatches.add(w);
1423                                }
1424                        }
1425                }
1426                if (!freeMatches.isEmpty()) return freeMatches.get(0);
1427                if (!allMatches.isEmpty()) return allMatches.get(0);
1428                
1429                // if the best-match tier includes a weapon that we already own, filter out all non-free ones
1430                boolean hasFree = false;
1431                boolean hasNonBlackMarket = false;
1432                for (AvailableWeapon w : best.getItems()) {
1433                        if (w.getPrice() <= 0) {
1434                                hasFree = true;
1435                        }
1436                        if (w.getSubmarket() == null || !w.getSubmarket().getPlugin().isBlackMarket()) {
1437                                hasNonBlackMarket = true;
1438                        }
1439                }
1440                if (hasFree) {
1441                        for (AvailableWeapon w : new ArrayList<AvailableWeapon>(best.getItems())) {
1442                                if (w.getPrice() > 0) {
1443                                        best.remove(w); 
1444                                }
1445                        }
1446                } else if (hasNonBlackMarket) {
1447                        for (AvailableWeapon w : new ArrayList<AvailableWeapon>(best.getItems())) {
1448                                if (w.getSubmarket() != null && w.getSubmarket().getPlugin().isBlackMarket()) {
1449                                        best.remove(w); 
1450                                }
1451                        }
1452                }
1453                
1454                // if the best-match tier includes a weapon we used already, use that
1455                if (!alreadyUsed.isEmpty()) {
1456                        for (AvailableWeapon w : best.getItems()) {
1457                                if (alreadyUsed.contains(w.getId())) return w;
1458                        }
1459                }
1460                
1461                if (best.isEmpty()) return null;
1462                
1463                //return best.getItems().get(0);
1464                return best.pick();
1465        }

1540                // if the best-match tier includes a fighter that we already own, filter out all non-free ones

1543                boolean hasNonBlackMarket = false;
1544                for (AvailableFighter f : best.getItems()) {
1545                        if (f.getPrice() <= 0) {
1546                                hasFree = true;
1547                        }
1548                        if (f.getSubmarket() == null || !f.getSubmarket().getPlugin().isBlackMarket()) {
1549                                hasNonBlackMarket = true;
1550                        }
1551                }
1552                if (hasFree) {
1553                        for (AvailableFighter f : new ArrayList<AvailableFighter>(best.getItems())) {
1554                                if (f.getPrice() > 0) {
1555                                        best.remove(f); 
1556                                }
1557                        }
1558                } else if (hasNonBlackMarket) {
1559                        for (AvailableFighter f : new ArrayList<AvailableFighter>(best.getItems())) {
1560                                if (f.getSubmarket() != null && f.getSubmarket().getPlugin().isBlackMarket()) {
1561                                        best.remove(f); 
1562                                }
1563                        }
1564                }

1595        public float getLevel(String tag) {
1596                Integer result = tagLevels.get(tag);
1597                if (result != null) return result;
1598                Category cat = categories.get(tag);
1599                if (cat == null) {
1600                        tagLevels.put(tag, -1);
1601                        return -1f;
1602                }
1603                try {
1604                        result = (int) Float.parseFloat(tag.replaceAll(cat.base, ""));
1605                        tagLevels.put(tag, result);
1606                        return result;
1607                } catch (Throwable t) {
1608                        tagLevels.put(tag, -1);
1609                        return -1f;
1610                }
1611        }

1635        public List<WeaponSlotAPI> getWeaponSlotsInPriorityOrder(ShipVariantAPI current, ShipVariantAPI target, boolean upgradeMode) {
1636                List<WeaponSlotAPI> result = new ArrayList<WeaponSlotAPI>();
1637
1638                for (WeaponSlotAPI slot : current.getHullSpec().getAllWeaponSlotsCopy()) {
1639                        if (slot.isBuiltIn() || slot.isDecorative()) continue;
1640                        if (target.getWeaponId(slot.getId()) == null) continue;
1641                        if (!upgradeMode && current.getWeaponId(slot.getId()) != null) continue;
1642                        result.add(slot);
1643                }
1644                
1645                Collections.sort(result, new Comparator<WeaponSlotAPI>() {
1646                        public int compare(WeaponSlotAPI w1, WeaponSlotAPI w2) {
1647                                float s1 = getSlotPriorityScore(w1);
1648                                float s2 = getSlotPriorityScore(w2);
1649                                return (int) Math.signum(s2 - s1);
1650                        }
1651                });
1652                
1653                return result;
1654        }
1655
1656        public float getSlotPriorityScore(WeaponSlotAPI slot) {
1657                float score = 0;
1658                
1659                switch (slot.getSlotSize()) {
1660                case LARGE: score = 10000; break;
1661                case MEDIUM: score = 5000; break;
1662                case SMALL: score = 2500; break;
1663                }
1664                float angleDiff = Misc.getAngleDiff(slot.getAngle(), 0);
1665                boolean front = Misc.isInArc(slot.getAngle(), slot.getArc(), 0);
1666                if (front) {
1667                        //score += 10f;
1668                        score += 180f - angleDiff;
1669                }
1670                
1671                return score;
1672        }

1676        public List<AvailableWeapon> getPossibleWeapons(WeaponSlotAPI slot, WeaponSpecAPI desired, ShipVariantAPI current, float opLeft, List<AvailableWeapon> weapons) {
1677                List<AvailableWeapon> result = new ArrayList<AvailableWeapon>();
1678                
1679                for (AvailableWeapon w : weapons) {
1680                        if (w.getQuantity() <= 0) continue;
1681                        
1682                        WeaponSpecAPI spec = w.getSpec();
1683                        //float cost = spec.getOrdnancePointCost(stats, current.getStatsForOpCosts());
1684                        float cost = w.getOPCost(stats, current.getStatsForOpCosts());
1685                        if (cost > opLeft) continue;
1686                        if (!slot.weaponFits(spec)) continue;
1687                        
1688                        if (spec != desired && 
1689                                        (spec.getType() == WeaponType.MISSILE || spec.getAIHints().contains(AIHints.STRIKE))) {
1690                                boolean guided = spec.getAIHints().contains(AIHints.DO_NOT_AIM);
1691                                if (!guided) {
1692                                        boolean guidedPoor = spec.getAIHints().contains(AIHints.GUIDED_POOR);
1693                                        float angleDiff = Misc.getDistanceFromArc(slot.getAngle(), slot.getArc(), 0);
1694                                        if (angleDiff > 45 || (!guidedPoor && angleDiff > 20)) continue;
1695                                }
1696                        }
1697                        
1698                        result.add(w);
1699                }
1700                
1701                if (randomize && false) {
1702                        Random filterRandom = new Random(weaponFilterSeed);
1703                        int num = Math.max(1, result.size() / 3 * 2);
1704                        Set<Integer> picks = DefaultFleetInflater.makePicks(num, result.size(), filterRandom);
1705                        List<AvailableWeapon> filtered = new ArrayList<AvailableWeapon>();
1706                        for (Integer pick : picks) {
1707                                filtered.add(result.get(pick));
1708                        }
1709                        result = filtered;
1710                }
1711

1726        public List<AvailableFighter> getPossibleFighters(ShipVariantAPI current, float opLeft, List<AvailableFighter> fighters) {
1727                List<AvailableFighter> result = new ArrayList<AvailableFighter>();
1728                
1729                for (AvailableFighter f : fighters) {
1730                        if (f.getQuantity() <= 0) continue;
1731                        
1732                        FighterWingSpecAPI spec = f.getWingSpec();
1733                        float cost = spec.getOpCost(current.getStatsForOpCosts());
1734                        if (cost > opLeft) continue;
1735                        
1736                        result.add(f);
1737                }
1738                
1739                if (randomize) {
1740                        Random filterRandom = new Random(weaponFilterSeed);
1741                        int num = Math.max(1, result.size() / 3 * 2);
1742                        Set<Integer> picks = DefaultFleetInflater.makePicks(num, result.size(), filterRandom);
1743                        List<AvailableFighter> filtered = new ArrayList<AvailableFighter>();
1744                        for (Integer pick : picks) {
1745                                filtered.add(result.get(pick));
1746                        }
1747                        result = filtered;
1748                }
1749                
1750                return result;
1751        }

1840        @Override
1841        public void autoAssignOfficers(CampaignFleetAPI fleet) {
1842                List<FleetMemberAPI> members = new ArrayList<FleetMemberAPI>();
1843                for (FleetMemberAPI member : fleet.getFleetData().getMembersListCopy()) {
1844                        if (member.isMothballed()) {
1845                                continue;
1846                        }
1847                        if (!member.getCaptain().isDefault()) {
1848                                continue;
1849                        }
1850                        if (fleet.isPlayerFleet() && Misc.isAutomated(member)) continue;
1851                        members.add(member);
1852                }
1853                
1854                List<OfficerDataAPI> officers = new ArrayList<OfficerDataAPI>();
1855                //int max = (int) fleet.getCommander().getStats().getOfficerNumber().getModifiedValue();
1856                //int count = 0;
1857                for (OfficerDataAPI officer : fleet.getFleetData().getOfficersCopy()) {
1858//                      boolean merc = Misc.isMercenary(officer.getPerson());
1859//                      if (!merc) {
1860//                              count++;
1861//                      }
1862                        if (!officer.isActivated()) continue;
1863                        //if (count > max && !merc) continue;
1864                        
1865                        boolean found = false;
1866                        for (FleetMemberAPI member : fleet.getFleetData().getMembersListCopy()) {
1867                                if (member.getCaptain() == officer.getPerson()) {
1868                                        found = true;
1869                                        break;
1870                                }
1871                        }
1872                        if (!found) {
1873                                officers.add(officer);
1874                        }
1875                }
1876
1877                
1878                List<AutoAssignScore> shipScores = new ArrayList<AutoAssignScore>();
1879                List<AutoAssignScore> officerScores = new ArrayList<AutoAssignScore>();
1880                
1881                float maxMemberTotal = 1f;
1882                float maxOfficerTotal = 1f;
1883                
1884                for (FleetMemberAPI member : members) {
1885                        AutoAssignScore score = new AutoAssignScore();
1886                        shipScores.add(score);
1887                        score.member = member;
1888                        score.score = computeMemberScore(member);
1889                        
1890                        maxMemberTotal = Math.max(maxMemberTotal, score.score[4]);
1891                }
1892                
1893                for (OfficerDataAPI officer : officers) {
1894                        AutoAssignScore score = new AutoAssignScore();
1895                        officerScores.add(score);
1896                        score.officer = officer.getPerson();
1897                        score.score = computeOfficerScore(officer.getPerson());
1898                        maxOfficerTotal = Math.max(maxOfficerTotal, score.score[4]);
1899                }
1900                
1901                for (AutoAssignScore score : officerScores) {
1902                        // so that the best officers are closer to the best ships
1903                        // and the lowest-level officers are still closer to the best ships than to the worst ships
1904                        score.score[4] = maxMemberTotal + (maxOfficerTotal - score.score[4]);
1905                }
1906                
1907                while (!shipScores.isEmpty() && !officerScores.isEmpty()) {
1908                        float minDist = Float.MAX_VALUE;
1909                        AutoAssignScore bestShip = null;
1910                        AutoAssignScore bestOfficer = null;
1911                        for (AutoAssignScore ship : shipScores) {
1912//                              if (ship.member.getHullId().equals("condor")) {
1913//                                      System.out.println("wefewfew");
1914//                              }
1915                                for (AutoAssignScore officer : officerScores) {
1916                                        float dist = Math.abs(ship.score[0] - officer.score[0]) + 
1917                                                                 Math.abs(ship.score[1] - officer.score[1]) +
1918                                                                 Math.abs(ship.score[2] - officer.score[2]) +
1919                                                                 Math.abs(ship.score[3] - officer.score[3]) +
1920                                                                 Math.abs(ship.score[4] - officer.score[4]);
1921
1922                                        if (dist < minDist) {
1923                                                minDist = dist;
1924                                                bestShip = ship;
1925                                                bestOfficer = officer;
1926                                        }
1927                                }
1928                        }
1929                        if (bestShip == null) {
1930                                break;
1931                        }
1932                        
1933                        shipScores.remove(bestShip);
1934                        officerScores.remove(bestOfficer);
1935                        bestShip.member.setCaptain(bestOfficer.officer);
1936                }
1937        }

1939        public float [] computeOfficerScore(PersonAPI officer) {
1940                float energy = 0f;
1941                float ballistic = 0f;
1942                float missile = 0f;
1943                float defense = 0f;
1944                float total = 0f;
1945                
1946                for (SkillLevelAPI sl : officer.getStats().getSkillsCopy()) {
1947                        if (!sl.getSkill().isCombatOfficerSkill()) continue;
1948                        float w = sl.getLevel();
1949                        if (w == 2) w = 1.33f; // weigh elite skills as less than double
1950                        if (w <= 0f) {
1951                                continue;
1952                        }
1953                        
1954                        if (sl.getSkill().hasTag(Skills.TAG_ENERGY_WEAPONS)) {
1955                                energy++;
1956                        } else if (sl.getSkill().hasTag(Skills.TAG_BALLISTIC_WEAPONS)) {
1957                                ballistic++;
1958                        } else if (sl.getSkill().hasTag(Skills.TAG_MISSILE_WEAPONS)) {
1959                                missile++;
1960                        } else if (sl.getSkill().hasTag(Skills.TAG_ACTIVE_DEFENSES)) {
1961                                defense++;
1962                        }
1963                        total++;
1964                }
1965                
1966                if (total < 1f) total = 1f;
1967                energy /= total;
1968                ballistic /= total;
1969                missile /= total;
1970                defense /= total;
1971                
1972                float [] result = new float [5];
1973                result[0] = energy;
1974                result[1] = ballistic;
1975                result[2] = missile;
1976                result[3] = defense;
1977                result[4] = total;
1978                return result;
1979        }
1980        
1981        public float [] computeMemberScore(FleetMemberAPI member) {
1982                float energy = 0f;
1983                float ballistic = 0f;
1984                float missile = 0f;
1985                float total = 0f;
1986                
1987                boolean civ = member.isCivilian();
1988                
1989                for (String slotId : member.getVariant().getFittedWeaponSlots()) {
1990                        WeaponSlotAPI slot = member.getVariant().getSlot(slotId);
1991                        if (slot.isDecorative() || slot.isSystemSlot()) continue;
1992                        
1993                        WeaponSpecAPI weapon = member.getVariant().getWeaponSpec(slotId);
1994                        float w = 1f;
1995                        switch (weapon.getSize()) {
1996                        case LARGE: w = 4f; break;
1997                        case MEDIUM: w = 2f; break;
1998                        case SMALL: w = 1f; break;
1999                        }
2000                        if (civ) w *= 0.1f;
2001                        WeaponType type = weapon.getType();
2002                        if (type == WeaponType.BALLISTIC) { 
2003                                ballistic += w;
2004                                total += w;
2005                        } else if (type == WeaponType.ENERGY) { 
2006                                energy += w;
2007                                total += w;
2008                        } else if (type == WeaponType.MISSILE) { 
2009                                missile += w;
2010                                total += w;
2011                        } else {
2012                                total += w;
2013                        }
2014                }
2015                if (total < 1f) total = 1f;
2016                energy /= total;
2017                ballistic /= total;
2018                missile /= total;
2019
2020                boolean d = member.getHullSpec().getShieldType() == ShieldType.FRONT ||
2021                                        member.getHullSpec().getShieldType() == ShieldType.OMNI || 
2022                                        member.getHullSpec().isPhase();
2023                
2024                float [] result = new float [5];
2025                result[0] = energy;
2026                result[1] = ballistic;
2027                result[2] = missile;
2028                if (d) {
2029                        result[3] = 1f;
2030                } else {
2031                        result[3] = 0f;
2032                }
2033                result[4] = total;
2034                
2035                return result;
2036        }

2041                float f = 1f;
2042                float op = member.getVariant().getHullSpec().getOrdnancePoints(stats);
2043                if (op > 0) {
2044                        f = (op - member.getVariant().getUnusedOP(stats)) / op;
2045                }
2046                return f;

2049        public float getSkillTotal(OfficerDataAPI officer, boolean carrier) {
2050                float total = 0f;
2051                for (SkillLevelAPI skill : officer.getPerson().getStats().getSkillsCopy()) {
2052                        SkillSpecAPI spec = skill.getSkill();
2053                        if (!spec.isCombatOfficerSkill()) continue;
2054                        
2055                        float level = skill.getLevel();
2056                        if (level <= 0) continue;
2057                        
2058                        if (!carrier || spec.hasTag(Skills.TAG_CARRIER)) {
2059                                total += level;
2060                        }
2061                }
2062                return total;
2063        }
