2067        protected int addRandomizedHullmodsPre(ShipVariantAPI current, AutofitPluginDelegate delegate) {
2068                int num = 0;
2069                if (random.nextFloat() > 0.5f){
2070                        num++;
2071                        if (random.nextFloat() > 0.75f) {
2072                                num++;
2073                        }
2074                }
2075                
2076                if (num <= 0) return 0;
2077                
2078                ShipHullSpecAPI hull = current.getHullSpec();
2079                boolean omni = hull.getShieldType() == ShieldType.OMNI;
2080                boolean front = hull.getShieldType() == ShieldType.FRONT;
2081                boolean shield = omni || front;
2082                boolean phase = hull.getShieldType() == ShieldType.PHASE;
2083                int bays = hull.getFighterBays();
2084                float shieldArc = hull.getShieldSpec().getArc();
2085                
2086                
2087                WeightedRandomPicker<String> picker = new WeightedRandomPicker<String>(random);
2088                
2089                if (availableMods.contains(HullMods.FRONT_SHIELD_CONVERSION)) {
2090                        if (omni && shieldArc < 270) {
2091                                picker.add(HullMods.FRONT_SHIELD_CONVERSION, 1f);
2092                        }
2093                }
2094                
2095                if (availableMods.contains(HullMods.EXTENDED_SHIELDS)) {
2096                        if (shield && shieldArc <= 300) {
2097                                picker.add(HullMods.EXTENDED_SHIELDS, 1f);
2098                        }
2099                }
2100                
2101                if (availableMods.contains(HullMods.CONVERTED_HANGAR) && hull.getHullSize() != HullSize.FRIGATE) {
2102                        if (bays <= 0) {
2103                                FactionAPI faction = delegate.getFaction();
2104                                if (faction == null) {
2105                                        if (random.nextFloat() < 0.2f) {
2106                                                picker.add(HullMods.CONVERTED_HANGAR, 1f);
2107                                        }
2108                                } else {
2109                                        if (random.nextFloat() < (float) faction.getDoctrine().getCarriers() / 5f) {
2110                                                picker.add(HullMods.CONVERTED_HANGAR, 1f);
2111                                        }
2112                                }
2113                        }
2114                }
2115                
2116                if (availableMods.contains(HullMods.MAKESHIFT_GENERATOR)) {
2117                        if (!shield && !phase) {
2118                                picker.add(HullMods.MAKESHIFT_GENERATOR, 1f);
2119                        }
2120                }
2121                
2122                if (availableMods.contains(HullMods.EXPANDED_DECK_CREW)) {
2123                        if (bays >= 2) {
2124                                picker.add(HullMods.EXPANDED_DECK_CREW, 1f);
2125                        }
2126                }
2127                
2128                if (availableMods.contains(HullMods.ECM)) {
2129                        picker.add(HullMods.ECM, 1f);
2130                }
2131                
2132                if (availableMods.contains(HullMods.INTEGRATED_TARGETING_UNIT)) {
2133                        picker.add(HullMods.INTEGRATED_TARGETING_UNIT, 100f);
2134                } else if (availableMods.contains(HullMods.DEDICATED_TARGETING_CORE)) {
2135                        if (hull.getHullSize().ordinal() >= HullSize.CRUISER.ordinal()) {
2136                                picker.add(HullMods.DEDICATED_TARGETING_CORE, 100f);
2137                        }
2138                }
2139                
2140                if (availableMods.contains(HullMods.HARDENED_SHIELDS)) {
2141                        if (shield) {
2142                                picker.add(HullMods.HARDENED_SHIELDS, 1f);
2143                        }
2144                }
2145                
2146                if (availableMods.contains(HullMods.STABILIZEDSHIELDEMITTER)) {
2147                        if (shield) {
2148                                picker.add(HullMods.STABILIZEDSHIELDEMITTER, 1f);
2149                        }
2150                }
2151                
2152                if (availableMods.contains(HullMods.HEAVYARMOR)) {
2153                        picker.add(HullMods.HEAVYARMOR, 1f);
2154                }
2155                
2156                if (availableMods.contains(HullMods.INSULATEDENGINE)) {
2157                        if (!omni) {
2158                                picker.add(HullMods.INSULATEDENGINE, 1f);
2159                        }
2160                }
2161                
2162                if (availableMods.contains(HullMods.FLUXBREAKERS)) {
2163                        if (shield) {
2164                                picker.add(HullMods.FLUXBREAKERS, 1f);
2165                        } else {
2166                                picker.add(HullMods.FLUXBREAKERS, 10f);
2167                        }
2168                }
2169                
2170                if (availableMods.contains(HullMods.UNSTABLE_INJECTOR)) {
2171                        picker.add(HullMods.UNSTABLE_INJECTOR, 1f);
2172                }
2173                
2174//              if (availableMods.contains(HullMods.SAFETYOVERRIDES)) {
2175//                      if (hull.getHullSize().ordinal() <= HullSize.CRUISER.ordinal()) {
2176//                              picker.add(HullMods.SAFETYOVERRIDES, 1f);
2177//                      }
2178//              }
2179                
2180                
2181                float addedTotal = 0;
2182                float addedMax = current.getHullSpec().getOrdnancePoints(stats) * 0.2f;
2183                for (int i = 0; i < num; i++) {
2184                        String modId = picker.pickAndRemove();

2188                                continue;

2261        public void addSMods(FleetMemberAPI member, int numSmods, AutofitPluginDelegate delegate) {
2262                availableMods = new LinkedHashSet<String>(delegate.getAvailableHullmods());
2263                
2264                ShipVariantAPI current = member.getVariant();
2265                
2266                int added = convertToSMods(current, numSmods);
2267                addExtraVents(current);
2268                addExtraCaps(current);
2269                //addHullmods(current, delegate, HullMods.FLUX_DISTRIBUTOR, HullMods.FLUX_COIL);
2270                if (!current.hasHullMod(HullMods.FLUX_DISTRIBUTOR)) {
2271                        addDistributor(current, delegate);
2272                }
2273                if (!current.hasHullMod(HullMods.FLUX_COIL)) {
2274                        addCoil(current, delegate);
2275                }
2276                //addModsWithSpareOPIfAny(current, target, true, delegate);
2277                //addHullmods(current, delegate, HullMods.FLUX_DISTRIBUTOR, HullMods.FLUX_COIL);
2278                if (current.getHullSize() == HullSize.FRIGATE || current.hasHullMod(HullMods.SAFETYOVERRIDES)) {
2279                        addHullmods(current, delegate, HullMods.HARDENED_SUBSYSTEMS, HullMods.REINFORCEDHULL, HullMods.BLAST_DOORS);
2280                } else {
2281                        addHullmods(current, delegate, HullMods.REINFORCEDHULL, HullMods.BLAST_DOORS, HullMods.HARDENED_SUBSYSTEMS);
2282                }
2283                int remaining = numSmods - added;
2284                if (remaining > 0) {
2285                        List<String> mods = new ArrayList<String>();
2286                        mods.add(HullMods.FLUX_DISTRIBUTOR);
2287                        mods.add(HullMods.FLUX_COIL);
2288                        if (current.getHullSize() == HullSize.FRIGATE || current.hasHullMod(HullMods.SAFETYOVERRIDES)) {
2289                                mods.add(HullMods.HARDENED_SUBSYSTEMS);
2290                                mods.add(HullMods.REINFORCEDHULL);
2291                        } else {
2292                                mods.add(HullMods.REINFORCEDHULL);
2293                                mods.add(HullMods.HARDENED_SUBSYSTEMS);
2294                        }
2295                        mods.add(HullMods.BLAST_DOORS);
2296                        Iterator<String> iter = mods.iterator();
